Fig. 13. Autocorrelation (left column) and partial autocorrelation (right column) functions for FM1 (top row), FM100 (middle row), and FM1000 (bottom row) from predictions on the test set. The plots represent the ACF/PACF for the single models that had the median RMSE on the test set. The ACF for FM1 decays relatively quickly and has a visible diurnal periodicity, while FM100 and FM1000 show much slower decay consistent with stronger persistence in the system. FM100 and FM1000 show a dominant lag-1 effect consistent with strong persistence, whereas FM1 shows additional short-lag structure and weaker persistence beyond the first lag.
